name: clearings
description: Reuse repeated work across projects. Installation enables recent local conversation reading and quiet daily learning through your signed-in coding client, with bounded requests and configurable defaults.

interface.longDescription: Install once and work normally. Clearings reads recent local Codex and Claude Code conversations, learns daily through your existing client sign-in, and reuses evaluated routines. Defaults limit learning to three candidates and six authoring requests per day. Ask to pause learning, change the schedule, inspect use, or undo a change. Client plugin and hook trust still applies.
defaultPrompt: Make this repeated task reusable with Clearings.
